## About
Bogar Truck & Trailer Parts & Service Depot sits on Huron Church Rd in Windsor. We focus on power train, frame and suspension work, and we carry parts for trucks and trailers from the brands fleets already know, like Bendix, Spicer, Stemco, Goodyear and Firestone.
Our shop handles air and hydraulic brakes, van body repairs, hydraulic wet lines, safety inspection stickers and more. One reviewer called us "Quality mechanics doing quality work," and our customers have given us a 4.6 rating from 107 Google reviews.

## Services
- Truck and trailer parts: Parts from all major brands for trucks and trailers, available at our Huron Church Rd depot.
- Brake systems, air and hydraulic: Service and repair for both air and hydraulic brake systems.
- Axles and full suspensions: Axle and suspension work for trucks and trailers.
- Hydraulic pumps, PTO and cylinders: Work on hydraulic pumps, PTO and cylinders.
- Van body repairs: Repair work on van bodies.
- Aluminum dump body repairs: Repair work on aluminum dump bodies.
- Air and fuel systems: Service for air and fuel systems.
- Safety inspection stickers: Safety inspection stickers for your trucks and trailers.

## FAQ
Q: Do you sell parts as well as do repairs?
A: Yes. We carry truck and trailer parts from all major brands, and our service department handles the repairs.

Q: Can you do safety inspection stickers?
A: Yes, safety inspection stickers are one of the services our shop provides.

Q: What are your hours on Friday?
A: On Friday we are open 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.
